contexts.text: Man is (then) as... a something confused and obscure.
(Such) Spirits are in a cold and obscure light...
The resuscitated man is as yet in an obscure life.
He had believed... that he should live an obscure life... SE 3890.
He passes from an obscure into a clear life... AC 2367:2.
A Church in which the perception of truth and good was so general and obscure...
Therefore it is called the dark chamber. Described.
The existence of colour requires something both obscure and snowy...

The cloud = the obscure light in which is the spiritual man... The obscurity itself... through which the sun's rays shine, is what is turned into colours; thus such as is the obscurity... such is the colour... The obscurity with the spiritual man... is falsity, which is the same as his intellectual proprium...
The voluntary proprium of man... continually pours into the intellectual part what is obscure or false...
Falsity beclouds truth, just as an obscure cloud does the light of the sun.
The cloud of Christians... is so obscure as to be darkness.
In the obscurity of an understanding which is not illustrated...
So that I was very much in obscurity.
The Lord... progressed from an obscure state to one more lucid. Haran = the first state, which was obscure.
An obscure state of the Lord, like that of man's childhood. Signified. AC 1435:end.
The Knowledges of celestial things in obscurity. Signified.
The west = what is obscure.
That obscure lumen is (then) turned into darkness.
(What is immaterial supposed to be obscure.)
The ideas (of Spirits) are not so obscure as those of man...

When the Church is in darkness, the Lord is obscured before them, insomuch that He does not appear... although the Lord is never obscured, but the man... but still the obscuration is predicated of the Lord.
For man is in what is most obscure.
If the object is in obscurity (Spirits can cause an illusory vision).
In an obscure general [perception]. Signified, Explained.

The perception of good and truth is only in obscurity with man, even a regenerate man; and still more so with him who is in external worship... The affections (also) when man is in corporeal things... are most general, consequently most obscure, however the man may think that it is not so. Explained. AC 2380:2.
By a description from such things, they are more obscured.
That... the state of the spiritual Church, relatively to that of the Celestial Church, is obscure. Signified, Explained.
This is the reason why with the spiritual there is what is relatively obscure. References. AC 2713.
The arcana that the good of the spiritual man is relatively obscure; and that this obscurity is illuminated by the Lord's Divine Human. Explained. AC 2718. AC 2718:7.
But still the spiritual can come from obscurity into light, if they are only willing to be in the affirmative...
The man of the Spiritual Church is in obscurity relatively; and doctrine is therefore to be clothed with such appearances as are of human thought and affection. Signified.
The Ancient Church... was relatively in obscurity.
That the first state (of this New Church) was obscure. Treated of.
The cave of Machpelah = what is obscure of faith. Explained.
A cave = what is obscure, because it is a dark place; a cave of a mountain = what is obscure of good; a cave of the field of Machpelah = what is obscure of truth...

Those who are being regenerated, and are becoming spiritual, are in the greatest obscurity as to truth... So long as good is in obscurity with them, so long is truth... They know only very obscurely that the Lord is good itself, etc. etc... Hence it is evident how greatly the spiritual are in obscurity; and still more so before regeneration...
That first state... that they were in obscurity of faith. Signified. AC 2946.

As those things with man which are... of the natural mind, are obscure relatively to those which are... in the rational mind, therefore by evening are signified those things which are relatively in obscurity...
Negatives of truth are there represented by dark and descending clouds.
For then such (spiritual) things appear to man both obscure and undelightful.
Life in what is obscure. Signified, Explained.
By what is obscure is here meant what is obscure of intelligence as to truth, and what is obscure of wisdom as to good...
That sunset = ... also what is obscure as to those things which are of good and truth. Illustrated.
After (good and angelic Spirits) have been in this obscure state... they return into their former state. Signified.

The things which were distant from Zion and Jerusalem represented what is obscure as to good and truth: all this which is in obscurity is called the land of the north, and also the sides of the earth.
As, moreover, all the good which inflows with light from the Lord is terminated in the obscurity of man, the north is also called the assembly.
See North.
A state as yet obscure. Signified, Explained.

The state of initiation which precedes conjunction is obscure relatively to the state of conjunction; for when man is being initiated into truth and thence into good, all which he then learns is obscure to him; but when good is being conjoined with him, and he thence looks at truth, it becomes clear to him...
Hence it can be known in what obscurity are those who are such...
This zeal... in a still more interior form, is only an obscure something which intercepts heavenly delight...
The good of truth in a state of good, but in what is obscure, such as belongs to the Natural. Signified, Explained.
For when man is in the body, corporeal and worldly things occupy his thoughts, which induce what is obscure...
The sun shall be darkened... () = that love to the Lord... will not appear...
Those who are in... the love of self and of the world... induce on themselves this obscuration.
Man can only perceive obscurely...
Because good... inflows into man's obscurity which he has from worldly and corporeal things.
In a dream by night = the obscure perception of that good when left to itself.
Therefore the things here said... cannot but be obscure...
In this obscure state. Signified.
To pass the night, and also the night, = an obscure state.
Because to them truth is in obscurity; for they call that truth which they have learned from doctrinal things...
For I was in the opinion that what is general (must) be obscure. Explained.
These things are obscure to those who are in the light of the world...
As they are generals, they are also relatively obscure...
That the obscurity was dissipated. Signified.
To cover herself with a veil = to obscure truth.
This combat... man perceives so obscurely that... For man, especially he who believes nothing concerning influx, is in a state altogether obscure...
When the Internal acts into the External, as in the world, the sensation is dulled and obscured.
The event which to them was in obscurity. Signified, Explained.
Night = a state of shade induced by falsity from evil; thus also what is obscure of the mind.
The obscurity which is of night in the work is natural obscurity; but the obscurity which is of night in the other life is spiritual obscurity...

Moreover, spiritual obscurity is threefold; one which is from the falsity of evil; a second which is from ignorance of the truth; a third which is that of exterior things relatively to interior ones... Still, all these kinds come forth from the fact that the light of Heaven... is not received...
Apperception from the Sensuous is relatively obscure.
An obscure state. Signified.
To sleep = an obscure state. Explained.
(A general state of illustration) in that obscurity. Signified.
A dream = an obscure state.
It is called obscurity, because truths are exterminated; for where there are no truths, there is obscurity...

What is here meant by obscurity (is) the state of the Natural when good scientifics have been exterminated by scientifics of no use. Such an obscurity is what can be illustrated generally; whereas an obscurity from falsities cannot be illustrated at all... AC 5224, Explained.
Obscure revelation. Signified, Explained.
Obscure, in the spiritual sense, is that truth does not appear.
Those who are in falsity from evil are in the obscurity of night.
That night = what is obscure. Illustrated.
The things at the sides appear obscurely.
His obscure perception. Signified, Explained.
Hence (these) more than all others in the Spiritual Church, are in obscurity.
To lie down = obscure life.
(Such) have the understanding obscured...
Man, while he lives in the body, feels... very obscurely the things which come forth in his spirit.
Their possession in the Lord's Kingdom while they are as yet in obscurity. Signified, Explained.

For those who are being elevated into Heaven are first in obscurity; for they cannot come to clearness until they have been in Heaven, and have been instructed... for there is need of a space of time, in order that the obscurity induced by falsities may be dissipated.
Hence it is, that life in exteriors is obscure relatively to life in interiors; for in exteriors there is a general life...
(Bury me...) at the cave = where is what is obscure.
In the exterior Natural, where are the truths and goods which are represented by the sons of Israel, there is what is obscure, because what is general is there.

Those with whom... the obscurity of faith can be made clear. Signified. The case is this: whatever is in the Natural, and still more in the exterior Natural, is obscure relatively to those things which are in the interior Natural, and still more relatively to those things which are in the Rational; but this obscurity is made clear in two ways; firstly, if exterior things are reduced to compliance with interior ones... secondly, if the man can be elevated from exterior to interior things, and thus can see exterior things from interior ones; the latter exists with those who are in the Internal of the Church; but the former with those who are in its External.

For the man of the Spiritual Church is relatively in obscurity, and reasons concerning truths as to whether they are truths, or confirms those things which are called doctrine, and this without a perception as to whether what he confirms is true or not; and, when he has confirmed it with himself, he quite believes that it is true, although it may be false... AC 6945:2.
The cave of the field of Machpelah = faith in obscurity... thus the beginning of regeneration; for then faith is in obscurity.

For the Natural is relatively in obscurity: that it is in obscurity [is from the fact that it is] in the light of the world, and thence at the same time in worldly things; and when the light of Heaven inflows into these, the apperception becomes obscure.
That from a glad mind they may worship the Lord in obscurity of faith in which they are. Signified, Explained.
That those who are of the Spiritual Church are relatively in the obscurity of faith. References.
The ultimates which are with man, as also in nature, are... relatively general, and thence obscure... The Divine truth... in the way... becomes more general; thus more gross and obscure...
They know how to induce fallacies... and at the same time to obscure truths themselves.
Worship in what is obscure. Signified, Explained.
Those of the Spiritual Church are... in obscurity when they are emerging from a state of infestations and temptations. Explained... But this obscurity is then illustrated by degrees.
The obscuration of the whole mind thence. Signified, Explained.
Everything of perception, both obscure and not obscure. Signified, Explained.
One kind (of the Spirits of Jupiter) appear dark, almost black.
That when there is a state of illustration it is tempered by what is obscure of truth. Signified, Explained.
A cloud = what is obscure of truth; in special, the literal sense of the Word; for this sense, relatively to the internal sense, is what is obscure of truth.
That when there is a state of obscurity it is tempered by illustration from good. Signified, Explained.
That obscurity has seized them. Signified.

By night is here meant that obscurity which follows immediately after temptations; for those who are delivered thence come first into what is obscure, before they come into what is clear; for the falsities and evils injected by the Hells inhere for some time, and are dissipated only successively.
When it is evening, they are then in obscurity as to truths...
The appearance of the Divine obscured. Signified, Explained.
For the man of the Spiritual Church is in obscurity as to the truth of faith; and acknowledges for truth because the church has said so; not because he perceives truth.
Hence the Angels are alternately in the good of love, in the truth of faith, and in obscurity as to both...
Density = what is obscure, such as is that of the thought of man from sensuous lumen alone...
The appearing of celestial good in the greatest obscurity. Signified, Explained.
By obscurity is meant the obscurity of faith, such as is that of those of the Spiritual Church relatively to those of the Celestial Church.
The intimate of the Word which is thus relatively obscure. Signified, Explained.
From the obscurity which was before. Signified, Explained.
Towards the exteriors of that Heaven, where truths are in obscurity. Signified, Explained.
Conjunction with Heaven where good is in obscurity. Signified, Explained.
Good in obscurity. Signified, Explained.
Where the good of truth is in obscurity. Signified, Explained.
The obscurity and falsity of faith. Signified, Explained.
When man is in temptations, he is in obscurity from the evil and from the falsities of evil which are assaulting.
The sun shall be darkened... AR 27:2.
An entire Society first appeared as one obscure thing.
The west = love and its good in obscure perception... The north = wisdom and intelligence in obscure light.
The Angels... are then in their obscurity and undelight.
Twilight = the obscurity which precedes the morning.
A great obscure belt round the Sun, seen.
Afterwards the belt was seen to become more obscure.
The quality of their state was represented by the obscure belt.
The obscure delight... which (they had) in the world... is then turned into the delight of Heaven...
Compulsory worship is... obscure.
The sun and the air were darkened... () = that the light of truth became thick darkness. AE 541.
They love to be in obscurity...
If these were adduced, they would come into discussion, and thus into obscurity and ambiguity.
When they were present, all things... were so obscure and confused that...
The truth is obscured (by controversy). SE 3493.

Those who induce obscurities are such as in their life had been obscure in spiritual and celestial things... The obscurity is especially from this: that they have been in the love of self, and have set themselves before others.
What appears clear to man is obscure to good Spirits; and conversely. Explained.
What is obscure to Spirits is manifest to the Angels.
Negation is driven away; then doubt; then obscurity...
Those who had been in the dark ages... SE 5318.
The Russian nation have obscurity above all others.
The land is darkened () = the things of the Church in thick darkness, or in falsities.
Occurs. AE 652:10.
The perversion of the Church by falsity, is meant by, the land is darkened in the wrath of Jehovah Zebaoth ().
The garments of those who are in falsities... appear dark, and also spotted.
The signs of the presence of such are obscuration of the understanding, etc.
They began to be completely darkened as to the sight, and at the same time as to the understanding.
